prompt_md: You meet strangers one at a time, each with a birthday equally likely on any of 365 days. On average, how many do you meet until one shares your birthday?
prompt_short: Meeting strangers one by one. Average count until one shares your birthday?
hint_md: Each stranger is a fresh 1-in-365 chance.
explain_intuition_md: Every stranger has the same 1-in-365 chance, however many you've already met. A 1-in-365 chance takes 365 tries on average. Half a year, 183, sounds right but would only work if no birthday could come up twice.
explain_math_md: The wait is geometric with $p = \frac{1}{365}$, so $E = \frac{1}{p} = 365$.
